article.story: ALBANY, N.Y. -- — Sebastian Robinson's 17 points helped NJIT defeat Albany 77-68 on Thursday. Robinson also added six rebounds for the Highlanders (10-12, 5-2 America East Conference). Quentin Duncan scored 16 points, going 6 of 8 (4 for 6 from 3-point range). David Bolden shot 2 of 7 from the field, including 2 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 9 for 10 from the line to finish with 15 points. The Great Danes (7-15, 3-4) were led in scoring by Amir Lindsey, who finished with 23 points and six assists. Abdoulaye Fall added 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
